description: This PHP source file is part of a SuiteCRM module for managing project tasks. It initializes a list view of the current user's incomplete or upcoming tasks, loads the associated HTML template, sets query parameters, and displays the list. It also includes access control and layout editing features.

classes.name: ListView
classes.description: Class responsible for rendering list views within SuiteCRM, including initializing templates, setting queries, and processing the display.

methods.name: initNewXTemplate
methods.description: Initializes the template with specified HTML file and language strings.

methods.name: setHeaderTitle
methods.description: Sets the header title for the list view.

methods.name: setQuery
methods.description: Configures the SQL WHERE clause, ordering, and other query parameters for the list view.

methods.name: processListView
methods.description: Processes and renders the list view based on the provided seed bean and layout parameters.
